title: Random Hidden Morph by tucu
features: Its auto spamming morphs that are not even in the game,everything is fe,open source,the morphs are very old.
script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MainEvent")

local morphs = {
    "Turtle",
    "Kid",
    "Duck",
    "Duck",
    "Duck",
    "Crawler",
    "Dog",
    "Sheep",
    "Turkey",
    "Puppy",
    "Kitty",
    "Kitty",
    "Kitty",
    "Kitty",
}

while true do
    for _, morphName in ipairs(morphs) do
        remote:FireServer("Morph", morphName)
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end
